PLUGIN_CENTER_DESC: Manage plugins in this workspace: enable/disable, install, and reset.
PLUGIN_CENTER_HINT: Plugins are installed globally on the server, but enabled and configured per workspace.
PLUGIN_CENTER_ENABLE_AFTER_INSTALL: Enable in current workspace after install
PLUGIN_CENTER_RESTART_HINT: This plugin requires a server restart to fully take effect.
PLUGIN_CENTER_RESET_CONFIRM_DESC: This will clear workspace-scoped config for {{name}}.
PLUGIN_CENTER_UNINSTALL_CONFIRM_DESC: This will detach {{name}} from current workspace (global installation remains).
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_INVALID: Plugin package must be a zip file
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_MISSING: Plugin package is missing the root package directory
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_TOO_MANY_FILES: Plugin package contains too many files
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_UNCOMPRESSED_TOO_LARGE: Plugin package is too large after extraction
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE: A file in the plugin package is too large
PLUGIN_PACKAGE_HAS_SYMLINK: Plugin package contains unsafe symlink entries
